features.title: Transparent Pricing & Real-Time Booking

features.item2: Pay directly from your multi-currency balance with zero FX markups

faq.title: Hotel Booking FAQs
faq.q1: How do I pay for hotel bookings on Getly?
faq.a1: You can pay instantly using your Getly multi-currency balance or your virtual travel card without paying foreign transaction fees.
faq.q2: Are the room rates transparent with no hidden resort fees?
faq.a2: Yes, Getly displays the total checkout price including mandatory taxes and fees before you confirm.
